title: Storied Charleston Walking Tour by Author Liz Butler
blurb:
Join Liz as she leads you on a small group tour of her favorite city. Wander down cobblestone streets admiring window boxes and ironwork. Travel down alleyways and visit the stunning views of the harbor and Fort Sumter all while hearing the history of the city throughout its triumphs and tragedies.

Liz Legare Butler is a tenth-generation Charlestonian, an award-winning author, a recipient of the 2020 Best of Charleston award, and has been a licensed tour guide since 2003. Her love of history, her family connection, and masterful storytelling make taking a tour with her especially interesting.
